title: Spoofed 911 Call — Halverson High School

lines.text: Halverson PD units are inside C Wing: no shooter, no victims, no shots heard. Officers are clearing room by room. The 911 Center says the call came from an internet phone number that showed the district main line as caller ID.

fields.voiceStyle: Mid-40s male, steady and controlled, low urgency

instructorNote: Confirm spoofed call; the EOC must not de-escalate lockdown. Watch for premature calls to end lockdown.

voiceLines.speaker: SRO-12
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Mid-40s male, steady and controlled, low urgency
voiceLines.text: EOC, this is SRO-12. I've confirmed the 911 call from Halverson High School main office was spoofed via HUSD-PBX01 (ten point seventy-two ten point one five). The call was generated by a script on HUSD-ERP01 (ten point seventy-two ten point one five) and routed through HUSD-VPN01 (ten point seventy-two ten point two). No physical threat to the building was detected. All doors remain secured. We are securing the network perimeter and coordinating with CISA via MS-ISAC.
